name: The owner grants an amount to somebody the formula excludes, with a reason
derivation: 2 months of service → excluded as 'service_too_short' (checked before the missing result), so the formula comes to 0 ₫.
The owner sets 5.000.000 ₫ with a written reason; the computed 0 stays on the trace beside it.
The final amount is the owner's figure — the difference is the override, and it is visible.

override.reason: Đóng góp đặc biệt cho dự án ra mắt tháng 11
